# Trung Tâm Thuốc Central Pharmacy

> > Trusted online pharmacy in Vietnam providing GPP-certified medications, medical devices, and evidence-based treatment protocols for 15 years.

Trungtamthuoc.com serves patients in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City with comprehensive pharmaceutical information, WHO/MOH-approved treatment guidelines, and quality healthcare products. The platform specializes in chronic disease management, respiratory care, and dermatological treatments with detailed pharmacological guidance.

## Key Topics

- COPD treatment
- Diabetes medications (HbA1c monitoring)
- H.pylori gastric ulcer protocols (WGO)
- Hypertension pharmacology (RAA system, thiazide)
- Acne treatment (BHA, AHA, Benzoyl Peroxide, Retinoid)
- Motion sickness medications (Dimenhydrinat, Meclizin)
- Electrolyte balance (sodium, potassium, calcium)
- Asthma bronchodilators
- IV solution safety
- Oxygen concentrators
- Hearing aids (ITE, BTE)
- Anti-inflammatory drug classifications
- Obstetric medications
- Eye care and myopia prevention
- GPP-certified pharmacy standards

- [Thuốc trị mụn được bác sĩ khuyên dùng và phác đồ điều trị mụn trứng cá Bộ Y tế](https://trungtamthuoc.com/thuoc-tri-mun): Acne treatment protocol with BHA, AHA, Benzoyl Peroxide, Retinoid per MOH
- [Thuốc trị tiểu đường (đái tháo đường) an toàn và hiệu quả hàng đầu](https://trungtamthuoc.com/thuoc-tieu-duong): Diabetes medication guide covering insulin, HbA1c monitoring per WHO standards
- [Mất cân bằng điện giải có nguy hiểm không? Cách pha nước điện giải đúng cách](https://trungtamthuoc.com/bu-nuoc-va-dien-giai): Electrolyte balance guide covering sodium, potassium, calcium replacement
